say:0:1511123001:1.text: At the center of the second mural, the god leads his followers into battle against a snake-bodied, human-headed being—the corrupted Hunting Goddess.
say:0:1511123001:1.source_cn: 第二幅长卷的中央，“神明”正率领祂的信徒，对抗着蛇身人...
say:0:1511123001:1.male: At the center of the second mural, the god leads his followers into battle against a snake-bodied, human-headed being—the corrupted Hunting Goddess.
say:0:1511123001:1.female: At the center of the second mural, the goddess leads her followers into battle against a snake-bodied, human-headed being—the corrupted Hunting Goddess.

say:1:1511123002:1.text: You recall how Satrana once described this mural—how blood from both god and beast filled the valley, painting it red, until even the moon above turned crimson.
say:1:1511123002:1.source_cn: 你想起萨忒娜之前对这幅壁画的描述——神明与怪物的鲜血浸...
say:1:1511123002:1.male: You recall how Satrana once described this mural—how blood from both god and beast filled the valley, painting it red, until even the moon above turned crimson.
say:1:1511123002:1.female: You recall how Satrana once described this mural—how blood from both god and beast filled the valley, painting it red, until even the moon above turned crimson.

say:2:1511123003:1.text: What a brutal war. Beneath the Blood Moon, the battlefield was like a bowl brimming with blood. But it wasn't the gods or monsters who bled, it was innocent mortals.
say:2:1511123003:1.source_cn: 那是一场多么残酷的战争啊。血月映照下，战场化为盛满鲜血...
say:2:1511123003:1.male: What a brutal war. Beneath the Blood Moon, the battlefield was like a bowl brimming with blood. But it wasn't the gods or monsters who bled, it was innocent mortals.
say:2:1511123003:1.female: What a brutal war. Beneath the Blood Moon, the battlefield was like a bowl brimming with blood. But it wasn't the gods or monsters who bled, it was innocent mortals.

say:3:1511123004:1.text: Now you understand why Dura, a goddess herself, was so determined to slay others of her kind. When deities descend, human resistance is but dust in the storm...
say:3:1511123004:1.source_cn: 你忽然想通了艾雅为何身为神明，却执着于弑神。当神力倾轧...
say:3:1511123004:1.male: Now you understand why Dura, a goddess herself, was so determined to slay others of her kind. When deities descend, human resistance is but dust in the storm...
say:3:1511123004:1.female: Now you understand why Dura, a goddess herself, was so determined to slay others of her kind. When deities descend, human resistance is but dust in the storm...

say:4:1511123005:1.text: Look! The sky outside is turning red.
say:4:1511123005:1.source_cn: 看啊，外面的天色，变红了。

say:6:1511123007:1.text: But no disaster has come. Was the prophecy wrong?
say:6:1511123007:1.source_cn: 但是，灾难并未发生。预言出错了吗？
say:6:1511123007:1.male: But no disaster has come. Was the prophecy wrong?
say:6:1511123007:1.female: But no disaster has come. Was the prophecy wrong?

say:7:1511123008:1.text: "When the Blood Moon returns, the doom of yore stirs once more." Suddenly, you realize the truth.
say:7:1511123008:1.source_cn: “当血月再次升起，过去的灾难将重演。”你忽然明白了这句...
say:7:1511123008:1.male: "When the Blood Moon returns, the doom of yore stirs once more." Suddenly, you realize the truth.
say:7:1511123008:1.female: "When the Blood Moon returns, the doom of yore stirs once more." Suddenly, you realize the truth.

say:8:1511123009:1.text: You've already lived through history and experienced its ancient disasters. In its own way, the prophecy has come true.
say:8:1511123009:1.source_cn: 你已经亲身投入历史洪流，经历了过去发生的灾难。一种往事...
say:8:1511123009:1.male: You've already lived through history and experienced its ancient disasters. In its own way, the prophecy has come true.
